department: Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (EECS)

deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026, 11:59 PM US Eastern (application opens September 15, 2026). OGE fee-waiver requests for December 1 deadlines are due November 18.
deadline.quote: The deadline for submitting completed applications is December 1, 2026.

also.quote: Deadline: December 1 at 11:59 PM Eastern Time

gre_general.value: EECS does not use GRE scores in admission (except for the LGO programme).
gre_general.quote: We do not use the GRE test scores during the admission process — regardless of citizenship — unless you are applying to the LGO Program, which does require the GRE.

gre_subject.quote: We do not use the GRE test scores during the admission process

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 100; IELTS 7 (IELTS preferred); Duolingo 130 accepted.
toefl_min.quote: 100 for the Internet-based test. EECS requires a minimum score of 7 on the IELTS. EECS requires a minimum of 130 on the Duolingo English test.

ielts_min.value: IELTS 7.0 overall; IELTS is preferred over TOEFL.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS exam is preferred over the TOEFL.

also.quote: EECS requires a minimum score of 7 on the IELTS.

english_waiver.value: EECS waives the test only for applicants meeting the central MIT exemption criteria, which exclude English-medium degrees from India.
english_waiver.quote: The Department will grant a waiver to any students who fit the criteria outlined on the central MIT admissions website.

supervisor.value: The EECS pages checked do not require a pre-arranged supervisor; research assistantships are offered by faculty after admission.

funding.value: EECS PhD students are fully funded (tuition, monthly stipend, medical insurance) for the whole programme, given satisfactory progress.
funding.quote: In the EECS PhD program, students are fully funded throughout the duration of their graduate program, assuming satisfactory progress in their research and in their academic PhD milestones.

entry_route.value: Admission is straight into the PhD from a bachelor's; students without a master's earn the MIT SM on the way. No terminal master's admission.
entry_route.quote: When we admit an applicant, it is into the PhD program. If you do not have a master’s degree when you apply, you will get that degree first before proceeding to the PhD.

notes: One EECS PhD admission covers Electrical Engineering, Computer Science and AI + Decision-making. Fee waivers go through OGE criteria only.
